# Swoonflicks

> Free parts of English short dramas, with links to watch the full series in each app.

## Dramas
- [Dragons Bow To The Trash](https://swoonflicks.com/dragons-bow-to-the-trash/): Fantasy drama on NetShort
- [Mommy, I'm Not Lying](https://swoonflicks.com/mommy-i-m-not-lying/): Family drama on ShortMax
- [Mech God from the Dark Side of the Moon](https://swoonflicks.com/mech-god-from-the-dark-side-of-the-moon/): Sci-Fi, Revenge drama on NetShort
- [The Unbound: Rise of the Godslayer](https://swoonflicks.com/the-unbound-rise-of-the-godslayer/): Fantasy drama on ShortMax
- [I Spoke Baby Dragon and Won Everyone Over!](https://swoonflicks.com/i-spoke-baby-dragon-and-won-everyone-over/): Fantasy drama on NetShort
- [Rejected Luna Is the Alpha Queen](https://swoonflicks.com/rejected-luna-is-the-alpha-queen/): Fantasy, Romance, Revenge drama on ReelShort
- [The Empress's Final Wish](https://swoonflicks.com/the-empresss-final-wish/): Royal, Family drama on ReelShort
- [My Billionaire Boss Won't Let Me Quit](https://swoonflicks.com/my-billionaire-boss-wont-let-me-quit/): Romance drama on ReelShort

## Creators
- [Invitation codes](https://swoonflicks.com/invite/): creator sign-up code for short drama affiliate programs
